content.rationale: S3-log fixes the source — changes and their descriptions come from `jj log`, descriptions living in jj metadata rather than the file store; M-layout places the module flat at src/jjlog.rs. It maps the command to a machine-readable form and parses it into `(change id, description)` pairs, so the verb reads a listing, not jj's output format; a failed crossing is carried as a value with its evidence and a spawn failure likewise (S3-err).
